sources.title: All MiniLM L6 V2 | Intel® Software Catalog
sources.snippet: Overview All-MiniLM-L6-v2 is a compact sentence embedding model from the Sentence Transformers project, featuring 22.7 million parameters and generating 384-dimensional vector representations. It was trained on 1B sentence pairs dataset using a self-supervised contrastive learning objective.
